_comment: Post media (demo-polish BM, implementation.md §1.7). KEYLESS: Provider + ServiceUri + ContainerName only;
auth is DefaultAzureCredential (the App Service managed identity). There is no connection-string or
account-key setting and no code path that reads one. Provider: Azure | Local | None. The committed
default None makes POST /api/media answer 503 while the rest of the API works; App Service overrides it
(Azure__BlobStorage__Provider, from infrastructure/modules/webapp.bicep). Local is honoured only when
Per-model token PRICES for the staff AI-usage cost view (GET /api/engine/usage, story 03a).
Bound to EngineUsagePricingOptions — a SEPARATE options class from GenerationOptions, which
AddEngineGeneration gates at startup on NFR-005 governance grounds; pricing is not part of that gate.
A model with NO entry here reports the explicit 'unpriced' state on the wire, never a $0 that reads
as free. Populating real $/token figures for a LIVE provider is config data entry performed in the
deployed environment (Generation__Pricing__Providers__... app settings), deliberately not committed
here: Foundry deployments are not version-pinned, so a committed price would silently go stale.
The Fake entry below is the one honest exception — Fake performs no egress and reports 0 tokens by
construction, so its zero rates are a fact rather than a placeholder.
